## Connect. Understand. Act.

Incorta is the **best data foundation for AI and decision-making.** Powered by **Direct Data Mapping®**, it connects directly to your source systems in real time, with no waiting and no complex, expensive data work. It automatically enriches your data with business context and lets you act on what you learn across your entire organization, without the pipelines, delays, or complexity that typically slow decisions down.

From ERP connectivity to semantic analytics to agentic workflows, Incorta gives your business a reliable foundation for AI and analytics, with governance built in, not bolted on, so you can make faster, smarter decisions at every level.

## Close the gap between insight and action

[Get a Live Demo](https://www.incorta.com/demo)

### Connect to any system

Incorta creates a live digital twin of your entire business - mapping relationships across every source, unifying structured and unstructured data, and automatically adapting to system changes so your data is always complete and decision-ready.

- **Live digital twin** of your entire operation
- **Entity relationships** mapped across every source
- **Structured and unstructured data** unified
- Near-real-time insights at enterprise scale

### Understandthe full picture of your data

Raw data means nothing without context. Incorta continuously enriches your data with a semantic layer that knows your business - surfacing patterns, root causes, and relationships automatically.

- Context-rich semantic analytics built automatically
- Direct Data Mapping® preserves 100% data fidelity
- 90% of business definitions auto-generated and AI-ready
- Natural language querying with instant answers
- Proactively surfaces patterns and root causes

[**Learn more about Direct Data Mapping® >**](https://www.incorta.com/demos)

### **Act** without ever leaving your workflow

Most platforms stop at the insight. Incorta takes it further - putting contextual intelligence directly into the agents, workflows, and tools your team already uses.

- **Agentic workflows** that execute decisions automatically, grounded in your semantic layer
- **Reverse ETL** pushes intelligence back into your source systems
- **100% accuracy** with ML guardrails and human oversight built in
- **Full compliance** and audit trails on every action

FAQ

What is a data foundation for AI?

A data foundation for AI is the underlying infrastructure that provides AI models with the live, accurate, and contextually rich data they need to generate trustworthy outputs. It includes data connectivity, semantic enrichment, governance, and the ability to act on AI recommendations within business workflows.

How is Incorta different from a data warehouse?

Traditional data warehouses aggregate and transform data before analysis, losing granularity and introducing latency. Incorta uses Direct Data Mapping® to analyze data at full fidelity directly from source systems, preserving every transaction-level detail without the delays and precision loss of ETL pipelines.

Why do AI projects fail without a strong data foundation?

95% of enterprise AI initiatives fail to deliver business value because they are built on fragmented, aggregated, or context-free data. AI models trained on incomplete data produce unreliable recommendations. Incorta solves this by providing live, semantically enriched, and governed data as the foundation for every AI initiative.

What is Direct Data Mapping®?

Direct Data Mapping® is Incorta's proprietary approach to data access that connects analytics directly to source system data without transformation or aggregation. It preserves 100% data fidelity, enabling AI and analytics to work with the exact same data as the source system — eliminating the precision loss that undermines AI accuracy.

Does Incorta support agentic AI workflows?

Yes. Incorta supports agentic AI workflows through purpose-built agents, a custom agent builder framework, and MCP protocol support for agent-to-agent collaboration. Agents are grounded in Incorta's governed semantic layer, ensuring every automated action is based on accurate, trusted business data.
